title: A balance equal to the limit does not warn, one cent over does
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure customer A holds Net 30 with a credit limit of $500.00 and unpaid invoices totalling exactly $500.00; customer B holds Net 30 with a $500.00 limit and unpaid invoices totalling $500.01.
  • Start on the Work Orders page.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Work Order".
  2. Pick customer A as the customer.
  3. Confirm the New Work Order window with its create button.
  4. Click "New Work Order".
  5. Pick customer B as the customer.
  6. Confirm the New Work Order window with its create button.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Work Order window opens.

Step 2:

  • The window shows customer A as the customer.

Step 3:

  • No over-credit confirmation opens.
  • The New Work Order goes straight on as for any customer. ($500.00 does not exceed $500.00.)

Step 4:

  • The New Work Order window opens.

Step 5:

  • The window shows the picked customer.

Step 6:

  • A confirmation opens titled "Confirmation" with the message "Are you sure you want to open a new work order? This customer is over their credit limit." and the buttons "Create" and "Cancel", worded exactly as before the release. ($500.01 exceeds $500.00 by one cent.)

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11678 (Story 9, Over Credit warning)

  • S9-R1: “When a user opens a new work order for a customer whose balance exceeds a credit limit above $0, and the customer is not on COD, Due on Receipt or Credit Hold, the existing confirmation shows unchanged: title "Confirmation", message "Are you sure you want to open a new work order? This customer is over their credit limit.", buttons "Create" and "Cancel".”
